topics.name: Canonical Identity Registry
topics.purpose: Define deterministic registry of all active canonical contract/member/topic/relation/operation/event identities for exact resolution and collision detection.

semantics.registry_rule: Registry is built from exact accepted/candidate active source set.
semantics.identity_rule: Every registered identity maps to exact source contract/member/revision metadata.
semantics.collision_rule: Conflicting active identity definitions produce explicit collision.
semantics.lookup_rule: Lookup is exact by canonical identity.
semantics.alias_rule: Aliases are separately registered and cannot silently shadow canonical identities.
semantics.projection_rule: Registry/index file is derived projection, not source-of-truth.
semantics.authority_rule: Registry presence grants no runtime authority.

invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority, canonical contract sources, generated projections, historical artifacts and runtime state remain separate identities/roles; no file becomes authoritative merely by name, path order, timestamp or discovery order.
Candidate canonical changes remain inert until exact format validation, identity/reference resolution, semantic diff, applicable governance/authorization and repository acceptance succeed.
